title: Judgment on the Whole Earth

questions.question: Behold, the LORD will empty the earth and make it what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 24:1 (ESV): "Behold, the LORD will empty the earth and make it desolate,"

questions.question: The earth lies defiled under its inhabitants; for they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, broken the everlasting what?
Therefore a curse devours the earth, and its inhabitants suffer for their what?
The city of chaos is broken down; every house is shut up so that none can what?
For the windows of heaven are opened, and the foundations of the earth are what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 24:18 (ESV): "and the foundations of the earth tremble."

questions.question: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 24:2 (ESV): "as with the people, so with the priest;"

questions.question: The wine mourns, the vine languishes, all the merry-hearted do what?
They do not drink wine with a song; strong drink is what to those who drink it?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 24:9 (ESV): "strong drink is bitter to those who drink it."

questions.question: From the ends of the earth we hear songs of praise, of glory to the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 24:16 (ESV): "of glory to the Righteous One."

questions.question: Terror and the pit and the snare are upon you, O inhabitant of the what?
The earth staggers like a what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 24:20 (ESV): "The earth staggers like a drunken man"

questions.question: On that day the LORD will punish the host of heaven, in heaven, and the kings of the earth, on the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 24:21 (ESV): "and the kings of the earth, on the earth."

questions.question: They will be gathered together as prisoners in a pit; they will be shut up in a prison, and after many days they will be what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 24:22 (ESV): "and after many days they will be punished."

questions.question: Then the moon will be confounded and the sun ashamed, for the LORD of hosts reigns on Mount Zion and in what?

key_verse_text: The earth lies defiled under its inhabitants; for they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, broken the everlasting covenant.
